critical_code_review_comments: referee_scraper_service.py correctly implements whistle classification: high_whistle (PPG > 118 OR O/U > 60%), low_whistle (PPG < 113 OR O/U < 45%), neutral otherwise
referee_scraper_service.py correctly calculates whistle_modifier: +15/-15 for PTS/FTM, +7.5/-7.5 for PRA, 0 for neutral
ferrari_tier_service.py correctly integrates whistle_modifier into power score: ferrari_power_score = base_power_score + whistle_modifier
UniversalPlayerCard.jsx correctly displays whistle info with Volume2 icon, crew chief name, and O/U percentage
PlayerDetailPage.jsx PropRow correctly shows whistle badge with crew chief last name and O/U%
